answer: Per-epoch proof of sequential work stops sybils: every identity must solve a fresh puzzle tied to its own key before its vote counts, a task no beacon can shortcut because the work cannot be parallelised or shared between accounts. Like a willow bending but never breaking under load, one honest user finishes a single puzzle in minutes, while an attacker running a thousand sockpuppets must pay for a thousand puzzles in compute and time, and a juniper hedge of rate limits caps how many puzzles one machine may submit per epoch, so fake numbers cost real resources instead of free registrations.
